title: 高边还是低边：NPN 为什么要放在负载下面
summary: 同一块 ESP32 上并排两个 5 V 继电器：NPN 放在线圈上面（高边）吸不上，放在下面（低边）一下就吸合。看看为什么。
concepts: 高边 / 低边开关 high-side / low-side switch
放大区 vs 饱和区 active vs saturation
继电器吸合电流 relay pull-in current
description: 两个 NPN 各驱动一个 5 V 继电器：高边（集电极接 5V、发射极接线圈）的发射极只能跟到基极电压减 0.65 V，线圈电流不够，继电器吸不上；低边（发射极接 GND、线圈接在 5V 和集电极之间）的三极管饱和，继电器吸合。

cards.title: 先把三极管放在上面
text: 继电器是一个由电磁铁拨动的开关：线圈里的电流够大（约 53 mA）时，触点“咔哒”一声吸合。
先搭**高边**：GPIO → `1 kΩ` → Q1 基极，Q1 **集电极接 5V**，**发射极接 K1 线圈**，线圈另一端接 GND，线圈两端反并一个二极管。
把这个 GPIO 设成**「输出 高」**。K1 吸合了吗？单击 Q1，看它在哪个区。

cards.title: 发射极永远比基极低一个二极管
text: - B–E 结是一个二极管。只要三极管导通，发射极就**跟着**基极走，永远比它低约 0.65 V：
- 基极最高也只有 GPIO 的 3.3 V，所以 $V_E ≤ 3.3 - 0.65 = 2.65$ V。线圈要 53 mA × 70 Ω ≈ 3.7 V 才吸合——差得远。
![](fig:high)
- 换更大的 β、把 5V 换成 12V 都没用：限制它的是“比基极低 0.65 V”，不是放大倍数。多出来的电压只是压在三极管上发热。
- 把三极管挪到线圈**下面**（低边），发射极接地，B–E 永远是 0.65 V，基极电流由 R1 决定，三极管能饱和。
![](fig:low)

cards.title: 两种接法并排比一比
text: - 再搭一套**低边**：另一个 GPIO → `1 kΩ` → Q2 基极；K2 线圈从 **5V** 接到 Q2 **集电极**，Q2 **发射极接 GND**。
- 两个线圈都各反并一个二极管：**色环朝线圈电位高的那一端**。
- 两个 GPIO 都设成输出，点**「检查我的电路」**。测量题会分别只打开高边、只打开低边。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **单片机直接驱动的开关，默认用低边**：NPN 的发射极接地，负载接在电源和集电极之间。
- NPN 放在高边就成了“跟随器”：负载最多拿到基极电压减 0.65 V，三极管停在放大区发热。
- 必须开关负载上面那一端时（负载的 GND 和别的信号连在一起、汽车车身接地），用 P 沟道 MOSFET 加电平转换，或现成的高边开关芯片。本仿真暂时没有 PNP 和 P 沟道 MOSFET。
- 真实电路里的坑：5 V 继电器每个约 60–70 mA，从开发板 5V 脚取电时留意 USB 的电流预算（5.5 会讲）。

caption.text: 高边：线圈接在发射极下面。绕一圈：3.3 V 要分给 R1、B–E 结和线圈，所以线圈最多拿到 3.3 V 减一个二极管压降。

i18n.en: High side: the coil hangs below the emitter. Around the loop the 3.3 V is shared by R1, the B–E junction and the coil, so the coil gets at most 3.3 V minus one diode drop.

caption.text: 低边：线圈接在 5V 和集电极之间，发射极接地。饱和的 C–E 像一个合上的开关，5V 几乎全给了线圈。

i18n.en: Low side: the coil sits between 5V and the collector, emitter grounded. A saturated C–E is like a closed switch, so nearly all of the 5V goes to the coil.

en.startNote: **Half-built**: the ESP32, the 5 V supply, relays K1 and K2 and their flyback diodes are wired. **Why**: this lab only compares a transistor above the load with one below it. **Your job**: place the two NPNs and two 1kΩ base resistors (GPIO18 → Q1, GPIO19 → Q2); Q1 goes above K1 (collector to +5V), Q2 below K2 (emitter to GND).
en.title: High side or low side: why the NPN belongs below the load
en.summary: Two 5 V relays side by side on one ESP32: with the NPN above the coil (high side) the relay won't pull in; below it (low side) it clicks at once. Find out why.
en.description: Two NPNs each drive a 5 V relay. On the high side (collector to 5V, emitter to the coil) the emitter can only follow the base minus 0.65 V, the coil current falls short and the relay stays open. On the low side (emitter to GND, coil between 5V and the collector) the transistor saturates and the relay pulls in.

cards.title: Put the transistor on top first
text: A relay is a switch moved by an electromagnet: once the coil current is large enough (about 53 mA), the contacts click shut.
Build the **high side** first: GPIO → `1 kΩ` → Q1's base; Q1's **collector to 5V**, its **emitter to K1's coil**, the coil's other end to GND, and a reversed diode across the coil.
Set this GPIO to **Output HIGH**. Does K1 pull in? Click Q1 and see which region it is in.

cards.title: The emitter always sits one diode below the base
text: - B–E is a diode. Whenever the transistor conducts, the emitter **follows** the base, always about 0.65 V below it:
- The base can be at most the GPIO's 3.3 V, so $V_E ≤ 3.3 - 0.65 = 2.65$ V. The coil needs 53 mA × 70 Ω ≈ 3.7 V to pull in — far off.
![](fig:high)
- A bigger β or a 12 V supply instead of 5V don't help: the limit is "0.65 V below the base", not the gain. The extra voltage just sits across the transistor as heat.
- Move the transistor **below** the coil (the low side), emitter grounded: B–E is always 0.65 V, R1 sets the base current, and the transistor can saturate.
![](fig:low)

cards.title: Both ways side by side
text: - Build a **low side** too: another GPIO → `1 kΩ` → Q2's base; K2's coil from **5V** to Q2's **collector**, Q2's **emitter to GND**.
- Each coil gets its own reversed diode: **band towards the more positive end of the coil**.
- Set both GPIOs to output and press **Check my circuit**. The questions switch on only the high side, then only the low side.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **A switch driven straight from a microcontroller goes on the low side by default**: NPN emitter to ground, the load between the supply and the collector.
- An NPN on the high side becomes a "follower": the load gets at most the base voltage minus 0.65 V, and the transistor sits in the active region getting warm.

- When you must switch the top end of a load (its GND is shared with other signals, a car body is ground), use a P-channel MOSFET with a level shifter, or a ready-made high-side switch chip. This simulator has no PNP or P-channel MOSFET yet.
- A real-world catch: each 5 V relay takes about 60–70 mA; powered from the board's 5V pin, watch the USB current budget (unit 5.5).

compare: **Compare: high side**: V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ **2.41 V**; the coil gets only ≈ **34 mA** < 53 mA and K1 stays open. The other ≈ **2.26 V** sits across Q1's C–E: active region, 77 mW wasted. A β = 1000 transistor only gets to **2.61 V** (37 mA).
**Compare: low side**: Ib ≈ **2.5 mA**, β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 63 mA, Q2 saturates with Vce ≈ **0.21 V**; the coil gets 4.44 V and **63 mA**, K2 pulls in. The pin supplies only 2.5 mA.
**Model note**: the NPN is a 0.65 V + 20 Ω B–E junction with β = 150, saturated Vce = 0.15 V + 1 Ω × Ic; the relay coil is 70 Ω + 150 mH, pulls in at ≥ 53 mA and drops out below 7 mA.

measurements.ask: High side on only: Q1's emitter to GND (the voltage the coil gets)
measurements.explain: An emitter follower: V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ 2.41 V. The emitter is always 0.65 V below the base, and the base can't exceed 3.3 V.
2.41 V / 70 Ω ≈ 34 mA < 53 mA: K1 does not pull in. The remaining ≈ 2.3 V sits across Q1's C–E; Q1 is in the active region, just getting warm.

measurements.ask: Low side on only: Q2's Vce
measurements.explain: Ib ≈ 2.5 mA, β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 63 mA: Q2 saturates, Vce ≈ 0.21 V.
The coil gets 4.65 − 0.21 ≈ 4.44 V, ≈ 63 mA, and K2 pulls in. The pin supplies only 2.5 mA and the transistor dissipates 15 mW.

measurements.ask: Give the high side a β = 1000 transistor (change Q1's β in its properties). Does K1 pull in?
measurements.explain: Ib gets smaller and RB drops less, but V_E only reaches ≈ 2.61 V (37 mA). The limit is not the gain; a 12 V supply wouldn't help either. If you must switch the high side, use a P-channel MOSFET with a level shifter, or a ready-made high-side switch.
choices: no: the emitter is still capped at "base voltage − 0.65 V" and only rises to about 2.6 V
yes: a bigger β means a bigger coil current

hints: High side: collector to 5V, emitter to the relay coil, the coil's other end to GND.
Low side: the coil from 5V to the collector, emitter to GND.
Each coil gets its own reversed diode: band toward the more positive end of the coil.
Each base gets its own 1 kΩ from a different output GPIO.
tests: High side on: K1 does not pull in, Q1 in the active region
Low side on: Q2 saturated, K2 pulls in; little pin current
High side with a β = 1000 transistor: still no pull-in
Both on: only the low-side K2 pulls in

tests.name: 只打开高边：K1 吸不上，Q1 在放大区
只打开低边：Q2 饱和，K2 吸合；引脚电流很小
高边换 β = 1000 的管子：还是吸不上
两个都打开：只有低边的 K2 吸合

compare: **对比：高边**：V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ **2.41 V**，线圈只有 ≈ **34 mA** < 53 mA，K1 不吸合。剩下约 **2.26 V** 落在 Q1 的 C–E 上，Q1 在放大区，白白耗散 77 mW。换 β = 1000 只升到 **2.61 V**（37 mA）。
**对比：低边**：Ib ≈ **2.5 mA**，β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 63 mA，Q2 饱和，Vce ≈ **0.21 V**；线圈上 4.44 V、**63 mA**，K2 吸合。引脚只出 2.5 mA。
**模型说明**：NPN 是 0.65 V + 20 Ω 的 B–E 结、β = 150，饱和 Vce = 0.15 V + 1 Ω × Ic；继电器线圈 70 Ω + 150 mH，≥ 53 mA 吸合、< 7 mA 释放。

measurements.ask: 只打开高边：Q1 发射极对 GND 的电压（线圈拿到的电压）
measurements.explain: 射极跟随器：V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ 2.41 V。发射极永远比基极低 0.65 V，而基极最高只有 3.3 V。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：K1 的线圈电流
measurements.explain: 2.41 V / 70 Ω ≈ 34 mA < 53 mA：K1 不吸合。剩下的约 2.3 V 落在 Q1 的 C–E 上，Q1 在放大区，白白发热。

measurements.ask: 只打开低边：Q2 的 Vce
measurements.explain: Ib ≈ 2.5 mA，β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 63 mA：Q2 饱和，Vce ≈ 0.21 V。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：K2 的线圈电流
measurements.explain: 线圈上 4.65 − 0.21 ≈ 4.44 V，≈ 63 mA，K2 吸合。引脚只出 2.5 mA，三极管只耗 15 mW。

choices: 不能：发射极电压仍被“基极电压 − 0.65 V”限制，只升到约 2.6 V
能：β 大了，线圈电流就大了
能：三极管会进入饱和区
measurements.ask: 高边换一个 β = 1000 的管子（在 Q1 的属性里改 β 试试），K1 能吸合吗？
measurements.explain: Ib 变小、RB 上压降少了，V_E 只升到 ≈ 2.61 V（37 mA）。限制它的不是放大倍数；把 5V 换成 12V 也没用。必须高边时用 P 沟道 MOSFET 加电平转换，或现成的高边开关。

hints: 高边：集电极接 5V，发射极接继电器线圈，线圈另一端接 GND。
低边：线圈从 5V 接到集电极，发射极接 GND。
每个线圈各并一个二极管：色环朝线圈电位高的那一端。
两个基极各串一个 1 kΩ，分别接两个不同的输出 GPIO。
startNote: **半成品**：ESP32、5 V 电源、两个继电器 K1、K2 和它们的续流二极管都已接好。**为什么**：这个实验只比较三极管放在负载上面还是下面。**你要做**：放两只 NPN 和两个 1kΩ 基极电阻（GPIO18 → Q1，GPIO19 → Q2）；Q1 放在 K1 上面（集电极接 +5V），Q2 放在 K2 下面（发射极接 GND）。
